data.notes_barbara:
Overlapping customers; Different restaurant format; Different business mix

Both serve dining customers, but Flanigan’s focuses on casual dining and liquor retail rather than burger-led quick service.
data.notes_matthew: Flanigan's does run restaurants, but about 23% of its sales come from package liquor stores and the restaurants are full service bar and grills. It is also only 37 locations in South Florida on $205M, so I can't call it a direct comp.

data.reason: Casual seafood and steak dining plus package liquor stores; different products and retail mix.
Regional casual seafood restaurants plus package liquor stores; different format, alcohol retail, and small scale.
Operates restaurants and franchises its brand, earning food sales, franchise royalties and rent from leased properties.

Both sell prepared restaurant food to individual consumers, so customers overlap. Wendy's is a national quick-service burger brand run mostly through franchisees. Flanigan's runs casual sit-down seafood restaurants and sports bars, plus package liquor stores, all concentrated in South Florida. The format, the product mix (the liquor retail and the alcohol-led bar business) and the scale differ, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
Both sell prepared restaurant meals to lunch and dinner customers, including takeaway orders.

P1.1.text: Flanigan's - Laid back Family-run Restaurants in South Florida

P1.2.text: Beloved South Florida institution serving great food, drink, and fun; collection of family-run restaurants + sports bars open 365 days a year, lunch - late night.

P1.3.text: Treat yourself to the same great food you know in our restaurants, wherever you please.

P1.4.text: Pick up your ToGo order at any Flanigan's location.

P1.5.text: Lunchtime Legends is Flanigan’s NEW rewards program. Receive 5 points for every qualifying dollar spent between 11 AM and 4 PM when dining in the restaurant. Earn 5 points

P1.6.text: Wing It Wednesdays, Joe’s Meal Deals, Best Happy Hour In Town – take a look at these seriously stellar specials on offer. We’ve got you covered every day of the week!

P1.7.text: Touchdown. Slam Dunk. Homerun. Hole-In-One. Ace. Score. However you want to play it, Saturdays & Sundays are a total win with Happy Hour 11 AM - 7 PM & 9 PM to close.

P1.8.text: Welcome to the club! Join the Flan Club to receive the latest and greatest (think weekly specials, exclusive offers, news, special ‘gifts’ from us to you). Let’s be friends with benefits, sign up today.

P1.9.text: My how the family has grown! Come say hi at one of our multiple hyper-local locations sprinkled around South Florida. We’re always here for you, welcoming guests 365 days a year!

P1.10.text: It's 5 O'Clock Somewhere. Visit our sister shop, Big Daddy's Wine & Liquors, for beer, wine, and liquor needs at the best prices around. Cheers!

P2.2.text: The founding vision of Joe “Big Daddy” Flanigan – a come one, come all, home-away-from-home for friends old and new – is alive and well today. Over the years, Flanigan’s evolved from popular Big Daddy’s lounges and liquor stores into a group of over 20 restaurants.

P2.3.text: Flanigan’s is a laidback family-run restaurant anchored by a commitment to exceptional food and drink, warm hospitality, great value, and good fun. A beloved South Florida institution the Flanigan’s name is pretty much synonymous with good times. Flanigan’s welcomes guests from near and far every day of the year, serving continuously from lunch to late night.

P2.4.text: The founding vision of Joe “Big Daddy” Flanigan – a come one, come all, home-away-from-home for friends old and new – is alive and well today. Over the years, Flanigan’s evolved from popular Big Daddy’s lounges and liquor stores into a group of over 20 restaurants. An appreciation for shared meals with family and friends is at the heart of the Flanigan’s experience.

P2.5.text: Flanigan’s is very much a local neighborhood spot, and we exist to serve each community in which we make our home. The design of our bars and restaurants is all about the island vibes and saltwater adventures that reflect our deep South Florida roots. Our walls are lined with memories of family and friends playing in their natural nautical element – fishing, diving, beaching, and boating.

P2.6.text: And, oh yeah, those Legendary Baby Back Ribs…

P3.2.text: Our restaurants are open 365 days a year, serving continuously from 11:00 AM to late night. Whether you’re joining us in the dining room, bar (full menu available), or for take away – our team always looks forward to seeing your smiling face!

P3.4.text: Open So Flippin' Late (1am or Later, Every Night)
